headline: Quant Small Cap Fund exits ICICI Bank and cuts stakes in six other stocks in September
hook: Quant Small Cap exits ICICI Bank entirely
summary: Quant Small Cap Fund fully exited ICICI Bank and five other companies while reducing its stake in Zydus Wellness and five additional stocks during September. The fund also added six new entrants, including EPL Ltd and Moneyview, and increased its holdings in 10 companies like Adani Power and Emami. Total AUM stood at Rs 35,572 crore at the end of the month, managed against the Nifty Smallcap250 TRI benchmark. Retail investors tracking mutual fund allocation trends can observe shifting sector exposures, such as increased capital goods weight and reduced financial services exposure.
why_it_matters: Quant fund portfolio shifts signal changing institutional sentiment in specific stocks.

summary: Adani Power has submitted its compliance certificate under Regulation 74(5) of the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. headline: Adani Power signs deal for 770-MW Bhutan hydro project
hook: Adani Power expands into Bhutanese hydropower

This project is part of a larger 5,000-MW hydropower initiative in the region.
